technology_name: LDN193189 AND QL-XII-47 BASED COMPOSITION TO MIMIC THE EFFECTS OF ISCHEMIC PRECONDITIONING AGAINST CEREBRAL STROKE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Cerebral strokes cause rapid, irreversible neuronal death from ischemic injury due to a lack of immediate preventative neuroprotective defenses in high-risk patients.
description: A dual-action pharmaceutical composition blending LDN193189 and QL-XII-47 components to artificially induce ischemic preconditioning states, increasing cell survival thresholds across the central nervous system.
applications: Prophylactic stroke management for high-risk cohorts, post-ischemic neurological rehabilitation therapies, surgical brain protection protocols, and emergency stroke drugs.
